item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor las drag po bsad pa'i 'phyong
item.coloph: ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu bskor (skor) gyi drag po bsad pa'i 'phyong 'di yang / dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol sa gsum la 'gran zla bral ba'i grub dbang bstan 'dzin rin chen gyi yang srid kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin grags pa'i gser khrir skyong ba 7spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags kyis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ ma zad drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang rigs mthun stag rgod dbang 'dus sogs nas yang yang du bskul ba la brten/ rgod rje rgya yi rigs rus 'chang ba snyigs dus kyi kho bo g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bla ma'i cha tsam gtogs pa'i/ rgyal khams khol po ba des smin grol bka' lung 'chad pa'i thun mtshams su/ bon gyi 'dus gnas chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dus dang skabs la bab par dran nas/ dkar chag yi ger phab bo/

item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu bskor las drag po bsad pa'i 'phyong
item.coloph: ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrab gab pa dgu bskor (skor) gyi drag po bsad pa'i 'phyong 'di yang / dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol sa gsum la 'gran zla bral ba'i grub dbang bstan 'dzin rin chen gyi yang srid kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin grags pa'i gser khrir skyong ba 7 spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags gi (kyis) bka' gsung spyi bor phebs (phab) pa dang*/ ma zad drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang rigs mthun stag rgod drang srong dbang sogs nas yang yang du bskul ba la brten nas/ rgod rje rgya yi rigs rus 'chang ba snyigs dus kho bo g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bla ma'i cha tsam gtogs pa'i/ rgyal khams khol po ba des smin grol bka' lung 'chad pa'i thun 'tshams (mtshams) su/ bon gyi 'dus gnas chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dus dang skabs la bab par dran nas dkar chag yi ger phab pa'o//
